headword: {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}

definitions.explanation: A product or offer available only in limited numbers, often used to create urgency or exclusivity.

examples.japanese: {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}で{販売|はんばい}します。
examples.english: It will be sold in limited quantities.

examples.japanese: {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}100{個|こ}だからお{早|はや}めに。
{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}の{商品|しょうひん}はすぐ{売|う}り{切|き}れる。
examples.english: Limited quantity items sell out quickly.

notes:
{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい} is a common marketing term in Japan, often seen on signs and advertisements to indicate scarcity and encourage quick purchases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}{商品|しょうひん} (limited quantity product)
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}{販売|はんばい} (limited quantity sale)
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}○{個|こ} (limited to X units)

RELATED TERMS:
- {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}: limited time
- {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}: first-time only
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ: sold out
